title: chat-vtc-server: run leave effects on SpaceBan ejection
description: eject_banned_user (JMAP-8mem.10) sets leftAt via VtcBackend::update_object only. vtc 6bcd9d8 §Leaving a Call says that when the last active participant leaves a ring or scheduled call, the server transitions it to ended, and that when the last moderator leaves it SHOULD promote the earliest-joined authenticated participant. Those effects live in the private jmap-vtc-server participant.rs after_leave. Decide whether a ban ejection counts as a leave for these rules. If it does, expose a public leave helper from jmap-vtc-server and call it from eject_banned_user.
notes: Batch 8b review (JMAP-8mem.10): eject_banned_user now calls after_leave (crate-jmap-chat-vtc-server/src/lib.rs:376), but tests/cascades.rs lacks (1) a negative test for the state != Ended filter (lib.rs:335): seed an ended call bound to the Space with an active banned participant (leftAt null); dropping the filter makes after_leave/end_call return 'already ended'; (2) the ring-call branch: ban the initiator who is the only joined participant of a ringing ring call and assert it ends with endReason 'cancelled'. Only scheduled/completed and room/moderator-handoff paths are tested.
close_reason: Batch 19 (run wf_1f7c9883-837): implemented, adversarially verified, full CI green at b9d3d860
